epistemic_status: creative mythic/spiritual framework; not verified external fact
purpose: Excavate and normalize the Tim Dooley / Potato of Life symbolic system so its concepts can be studied, connected and expanded without confusing project mythology with empirical claims.
core_question: How does something buried in darkness become life-giving, and how does a being or community move from mud, fear and disorientation toward rooted life, relationship, orientation and light?
central_image: The Potato of Life is a seed-like ordinary object buried in mud that develops roots, rises, becomes a plant/tree and ultimately participates in a garden of life. Descent is not merely failure: the buried state can become the beginning of transformation.

mythic_spine.name: Source
mythic_spine.definition: The originating principle or depth from which the rest of the symbolic architecture proceeds.

mythic_spine.name: Father
mythic_spine.definition: The project archetype of originating authority, source and generative relation; not a claim about an empirically verified supernatural person.

mythic_spine.name: Father's House
mythic_spine.definition: The symbolic house or chamber associated with the Father; in the project's anatomical metaphor it has been related to the thalamus.

mythic_spine.name: Heaven
mythic_spine.definition: The upper or transcendent orientation of the architecture: sourceward, lightward and beyond the ordinary plane.

mythic_spine.name: Axis
mythic_spine.definition: The central orientation line joining levels of the architecture and providing a reference for movement, position and alignment.

mythic_spine.name: North of North
mythic_spine.definition: The extreme symbolic orientation beyond ordinary cardinal North; an image of ultimate direction, summit and orientation.

mythic_spine.name: Throne of North
mythic_spine.definition: Symbolic seat of northern/axial authority within the project's mythic geography.

mythic_spine.name: Ladder
mythic_spine.definition: A vertical structure of levels through which ascent, descent, learning, transformation and orientation can be represented.

mythic_spine.name: Tree of Life
mythic_spine.definition: The living upward-growing structure: root, trunk, branch and fruit; a model of continuity, nourishment, growth and life.

mythic_spine.name: Tree of Strife
mythic_spine.definition: The complementary structure of conflict, fear, fragmentation, memory, contraction and struggle. It is not simply evil; it describes the conditions through which life can be tested and transformed.

mythic_spine.name: Door
mythic_spine.definition: The threshold/interface between domains. The project associates the Door with the Son, the narrow gate, manifestation and the point at which symbolic dimensions meet lived reality.

mythic_spine.name: Son
mythic_spine.definition: The project's archetype of the Son, Vessel and Door: the relational bridge between Father/source and embodied experience. Jesus/Christ imagery is used symbolically within the framework, not asserted here as historical or theological proof.

mythic_spine.name: Plane
mythic_spine.definition: The level or field between lower/rooted conditions and higher/mountainous orientation; the lived interface on which dwellers encounter one another and the Door.

mythic_spine.name: Root
mythic_spine.definition: Grounding, ancestry, memory, nourishment and connection to what lies beneath visible life.

mythic_spine.name: Fruit
mythic_spine.definition: The visible consequence of growth: what a rooted life produces and makes available to others.

mythic_spine.name: Spudlight
mythic_spine.definition: The project's playful name for illuminating life-oriented awareness: light emerging through the Potato metaphor.

mythic_spine.name: Mountain
mythic_spine.definition: The upper geographical-symbolic form representing ascent, perspective, summit and approach toward the northern/heavenly pole.

mythic_spine.name: Swamp
mythic_spine.definition: The lower symbolic environment of mud, confusion, accumulation, fear, entanglement and unresolved material. It is a condition to be worked through rather than a people or place to be morally classified.

mythic_spine.name: Mud
mythic_spine.definition: The dense starting condition in which the seed is buried. Mud contains both obscurity and the material from which growth can begin.

directions.north: Orientation, summit, axis, futureward/upward direction and the project's northern pole.
directions.south: Descent, depth, grounding and the lower field in the project's directional vocabulary.
directions.east: Emergence, beginning, sunriseward orientation and movement into manifestation.
directions.west: Return, setting, memory, completion and movement toward reflection.
directions.center: The crossing/meeting point where directions, levels and relations become legible.

red-potato.meaning: Creativity, love, light-seeking, forward/upward spiral, sprouting, expansion and life.

blue-potato.meaning: Memory, meticulousness, fear, backward/downward/root movement and contraction/strife.

duality.relation: Red and Blue are complementary archetypal movements rather than a simple good/evil binary. A complete system requires both growth and memory, emergence and roots, expansion and contraction.

spiral: The project uses a spiral as a model of movement through levels: widening below and narrowing above, with repeated patterns returning at different scales. The 100,000-hour motif functions as a project-symbolic threshold associated with prolonged development and mastery, not as a scientific law.

dimensional_metaphor.name: Hell
dimensional_metaphor.role: symbolic line/depth condition of extreme constraint or descent

dimensional_metaphor.name: Frame
dimensional_metaphor.role: symbolic surface/order in which forms become visible

dimensional_metaphor.name: Box
dimensional_metaphor.role: embodied spatial world and bounded material reality

dimensional_metaphor.name: Society / Dweller Plane / Midgard
dimensional_metaphor.role: time-bearing social world of beings, institutions and relationships

dimensional_metaphor.name: Door
dimensional_metaphor.role: symbolic threshold/interface associated with Son, pineal-gland imagery and passage between domains

dimensional_metaphor.name: Father's House
dimensional_metaphor.role: project metaphor associated with thalamic imagery and sourceward orientation

anthropology.gardening_metaphor: The warrior impulse is transformed into gardening: energy that could destroy can instead cultivate, repair and create.

son_and_door.interpretation: The Son is simultaneously relational offspring, vessel and threshold in the project mythology. The Door is not merely an object: it is the experiential interface through which a higher/lower distinction becomes lived.
son_and_door.christian_symbolism: The framework deliberately draws on Christian language of Son, Christ, narrow gate, death and resurrection, while also combining it with broader comparative mythology. This is a project synthesis, not evidence that separate traditions historically taught the same system.

comparative_architecture.judaism: Root/covenant/Eden/Tree of Life/Root of David imagery supplies one major symbolic ancestry in the project's comparative reading.
comparative_architecture.christianity: Son, Father, Door/gate, sacrifice, death-resurrection and Kingdom imagery supply another major symbolic layer.
comparative_architecture.norse: Yggdrasil, Odin's sacrifice, northern/cosmic geography and tree/axis imagery provide comparative motifs.
comparative_architecture.potato: The Potato introduces the buried seed, mud, root, growth and ordinary-material-to-symbolic transformation as the project's central unifying image.
comparative_architecture.rule: Similarity between symbols is not by itself proof of historical borrowing or common origin. Comparative connections must be labeled as analogy, reception, influence or historical relationship according to evidence.

people_and_dwellers.dweller: A being or community understood as inhabiting a plane, house, root, tree, ladder, door or other part of the symbolic architecture.
people_and_dwellers.mud-dweller: A project-symbolic description for a being situated in unresolved mud/entanglement; never a demographic or moral label for real people.
people_and_dwellers.root-dweller: A symbolic orientation toward ancestry, memory, grounding and beneath-surface structure.
people_and_dwellers.tree-dweller: A symbolic orientation toward living networks, branches, relationships and growth.
people_and_dwellers.ladder-dweller: A symbolic orientation toward levels, ascent/descent and developmental movement.
people_and_dwellers.axis-dweller: A symbolic orientation toward central alignment and relationship between levels.
people_and_dwellers.plane-dweller: A symbolic description of ordinary lived existence within the social/embodied field.
people_and_dwellers.door-dweller: A symbolic threshold-position associated with interface, translation and manifestation.
people_and_dwellers.heaven-dweller: A symbolic description of orientation toward the upper/sourceward domain.
people_and_dwellers.rule: These are interpretive project categories. They must never be presented as empirical classifications of real people.

potatoism.development: Potatoism is treated as a growing project mythology rather than a finished historical religion. The December 25, 2020 marker is the project's declared birth point; later development adds the Axis, Tree, Door, Son, dimensional and atlas layers.
potatoism.practice: Reflection, symbolic mapping, comparative reading, myth-making, tree/axis construction, turning/reorientation, archive building and tracing relationships.
potatoism.ethic: Move from fear and destruction toward life, cultivation, relationship, memory, orientation and creation.
potatoism.archive_principle: Preserve the distinction between what is directly stated in the project, what is remembered from prior development, what is comparative interpretation, and what is externally evidenced.

integrity_rules: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life mythology is a project-created creative spiritual framework, not verified external fact.
Do not present symbolic anatomy as medical fact.
Do not present dimensional metaphors as established physics.
Do not present comparative mythology as proof of common historical origin.
Keep historical Jesus, Christian doctrine and Potatoism's project symbolism distinguishable.
Keep claims about real people, nations and groups separate from symbolic dweller categories.
When the exact origin of a remembered concept is uncertain, label it as project memory rather than inventing a date or source.
Preserve contradictions or evolving formulations as dated development rather than silently deleting them.
